metadata.coordinateSystem: WGS84 AEQD metres; x east, z north, y up
metadata.boundarySourceCRS: GCJ-02; iterative inverse conversion applied to WGS84 before AEQD
metadata.boundaryAccuracy: Generalized district outline from DataV; administrative and coastal detail approximate. Use OSM coastline for game land/ocean mask.
metadata.demAttribution: Terrain Tiles / Mapzen / AWS Open Data; upstream sources include SRTM, GMTED and others. See source record.
metadata.scope: 市南、市北、李沧、崂山、城阳、黄岛、即墨、胶州；不含平度、莱西
limitations: Actual DEM terrain only; buildings have separate estimated heights.
400m regional mesh loses small ridges; 32m grid covers old-town hills; a 40m Fushan patch covers its ridges.
DEM heights are not a surveyed street surface.
DataV administrative geometry is simplified and does not replace detailed OSM coastline.

landMask.source: OSM regional coastline polygons; local scene land overrides inside local scene bounds

detailLandMask.source: Local scene land inside its bbox, regional OSM coastline outside

metadata.landmarkTerrainNote: Old-town 32m grid and Fushan 40m grid sample genuine zoom-12 Terrarium (~31m pixels). Patch boundaries align with the 400m grid. Grid spacing is not survey accuracy; published peak elevations are not imposed on the DEM.
metadata.mountainRendering: Actual elevations with metre scale; finer 80m Laoshan surface, slope/height palette and mapped peak labels. No vertical exaggeration.

terrainPalette.source: Original rendering palette; unchanged OSM coast alpha, genuine DEM slope/height; urban tone inferred from observed building footprint density, not complete land-use mapping.

detailTerrainPalette.source: Original rendering palette; unchanged OSM coast alpha, genuine DEM slope/height; urban tone inferred from observed building footprint density, not complete land-use mapping.

terrain.layout: row-major; row 0=maxZ north; last row=minZ south
terrain.source: AWS Open Data / Mapzen Terrain Tiles (Terrarium)
terrain.heightUnits: metres; source vertical datum depends on upstream DEM
terrain.sampling: bilinear interpolation of genuine Terrarium DEM; no synthetic relief
terrain.seaNote: Source terrain includes water cells often zero/negative; use coastline land mask and ocean surface separately.

detailTerrain.layout: row-major; row 0=maxZ north; last row=minZ south
detailTerrain.source: AWS Open Data / Mapzen Terrain Tiles (Terrarium)
detailTerrain.heightUnits: metres; source vertical datum depends on upstream DEM
detailTerrain.sampling: bilinear interpolation of genuine Terrarium DEM; no synthetic relief
detailTerrain.seaNote: Source terrain includes water cells often zero/negative; use coastline land mask and ocean surface separately.

channels.r: approximate distance to rasterized OSM shoreline / 100m, capped at 1
channels.g: OSM coastline land mask: 1 land, 0 water

shoreTexture.uv: u=(x-minX)/(maxX-minX); v=(z-minZ)/(maxZ-minZ); texture invertY=true for v=0 south
shoreTexture.distanceAccuracy: Distance-transform approximation at approximately 68x57m regional pixels; use local shore-distance.png for fine Zhanqiao shoreline.
